hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.d.ts) exit 0;; *.ts|*.svelte) n=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ "$n" -gt 200 ]; then printf "{\"systemMessage\":\"%s is %s lines; docs/code-standards.md caps source files at 200. Consider splitting.\"}" "${f##*/}" "$n"; fi;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
